jsesh.tmp.mdcDisplayer.draw
Interface Layout

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractLayout
public interface Layout

Elements of this class are responsible for computing the position and dimensions of view elements.

A layout can change a view's width and height and it can also change the subview positions and scales.

Important - note that layout does just that -- layout -- and does in no way create view elements. View element creation is the task of ViewBuilder.

Method Detail

layout

public void layout(View view)
compute the view size (width and height). If the view has subviews, layout should compute their position in the parent view and scale them if required. Note that layout is not a recursive function.

view -
